# tools/

Developer tools for maintaining this repository, not part of the installed package. `docmap.py` generates
`docs/MAP.md`, the folder tables and the decision index, and checks docs and import boundaries
(`python tools/docmap.py check`); it is installed by the project-foundations skill and updated from there.
